svg.title: The A to F ship grade
svg.desc: Seven graded lanes produce one ship verdict; the weakest lane caps the grade. Instant-F triggers such as a hardcoded secret lock the grade to F with the exact file and line.
svg.text: the weakest lane caps the grade
Hardcoded secret, or a permission check bypassable via a request param → grade locks to F, with the exact file and line.
